package.name: slam_octvox
package.description:
Header-only vendoring of Super-LIO's OctVoxMap + HKNN search (GPLv3) for use as a pluggable map backend behind slam_core's IMapManager.
Contains modified copies of files from the Super-LIO project (https://github.com/Liansheng-Wang/Super-LIO), redistributed under GPLv3.
